manuscript.title: The joint Dickman law for consecutive integers
manuscript.main_claim: For every 0<a,b<1, ordinary natural density of 2<=n<=X where P+(n)<=n^a and P+(n+1)<=n^b converges to rho(1/a)rho(1/b). X ranges over all real cutoffs.
manuscript.order_corollary: Both strict orderings of P+(n),P+(n+1) have ordinary natural density one half.
additional_claims_outside_selected_theor: Fixed-threshold X^a,X^b limit and full joint distribution presentation
Upper-tail independence corollaries and proof's analytic steps

source_signatures: Tendsto (realDensity (fun n => (n.maxPrimeFac : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ a ∧ ((n + 1).maxPrimeFac : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ b)) atTop (𝓝 (rho (1/a)*rho (1/b))) for 0<a,b<1
